The wind had moved a door.

So the day was perfect.

Patience brings luck.

title: Anna and the Mystery
text:
One evening Anna heard a strange sound by the old well.

Butterflies flew around.

Curiously Anna went closer.

Behind a stone Anna discovered a colorful map.

The sky was blue.

Suddenly wind came up.

Suddenly a shooting star fell.

It was only the postman.

Everyone laughed and went home.

Sharing brings joy.

title: Milo's Most Beautiful Day
text:
One evening Milo heard a strange sound on the playground.

The sun shone warmly.

Bravely Milo followed the sound.

Behind a fence Milo discovered an old coin.

Birds sang cheerfully.

Suddenly something rustled loudly.

Suddenly wind came up.

A branch had fallen.

The adventure stayed unforgotten.

Laughter always helps.
